nativeTrajectory.scope: Continuous retained bikes, riders, pool, camera and mesh-cache updates; clock deltas and recorded user controls are external. Only atomic initial state enters browser; last frame stops inside world update. Particle drawing, full outer scene execution and normal-rate parity remain unproven. In full-heap mode terrain traversal/emission and allocator placement are computed from initial state.

normalRateStability.scope: Continuous two-bike runtime stability and exact Node/Chrome agreement at fixed 50 Hz. This does not prove native normal-speed parity or verify the playable site integration.
